posts.text: Congratulations to my dear brother, Tavis Smiley, on celebrating five years of KBLA 1580 and an extraordinary 45 years of courageous journalism! Your steadfast commitment to truth-telling, your spiritual and moral integrity, and your unwavering love for everyday people continue to shine brightly in a time that desperately needs authentic voices. You have never lost sight of the dignity of those too often overlooked, and your work stands as a powerful testament to service, justice, and compassion

Cornel West reflects on resisting political hatred, greed, and spectacle—describing Trump as an embodiment of those forces—while urging a response rooted in love, compassion, and moral discipline. Drawing on philosophical and civil rights traditions, he calls for a “noble discontent” that refuses to mirror idolatry with more idolatry, and instead centers human dignity and service! #TruthJusticeLove
@kbla1580 @tavissmiley
